annotations.title: Address checksum (EIP-55): validate and format an EVM address

description: Validate an EVM address and return its EIP-55 checksummed form, saying whether the input was all lower case, all upper case, correctly checksummed or mixed case with a wrong checksum (a likely typo). Works for every EVM chain. Use before sending funds or storing an address; for whether it is a contract use <chain>_is_contract. Example: address=0xd8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
